I had a really great experience with this dentist. He was very gentle, professional, and clearly knows what he’s doing. I appreciated that he never tried to push unnecessary treatments or products — only what I actually needed. He explained every step clearly, which made me feel comfortable and relaxed throughout the visit.

His assistant also worked incredibly well with him, and the whole team made the experience smooth and stress-free. Honestly, I didn’t even notice when he gave the injection! That says a lot about his skill and care. Highly recommend if you’re nervous about dental visits.

I've been a customer of Dr. for over 25 years. His skill in scaling and dental work is probably top-notch. I've been to government hospitals and other clinics and they couldn't compare. The dentist also provides excellent dental care and knowledge.
Later, when I got older and moved, my wife still goes to Dr. here. I highly recommend him.
